title: Part
description: The one part of a crossing message (crossing-2): exactly one body, as text, as raw bytes in standard base64, or as a JSON value; optionally its media type; and under the crossing extension its kind and its salt of exactly 32 bytes in lowercase hex, 64 digits. A url body counts as the one body, so a part with url and another body has two, and a part whose one body is url is refused by a rule of its own, since url is not a body of this version (crossing-2).

url.description: A url body, whatever its value. It counts as the part's one body, and a part whose body is url is refused by its own rule (crossing-2, url-unsupported).

base64.description: Standard base64 with padding, in the one encoding that decodes and encodes back to itself.

mediaType.description: A media type, lowercase: a type and a subtype of RFC 6838's restricted names, at most 127 characters each, and no parameters (crossing-2).
